## Data Info
Number of **formative** reviews per reviewer 
```{r}
db <- ifelse(interactive(), "local/narrate.db",  "../local/narrate.db")

rubric_version <- 3
last_modified <- format(file.info(db)$mtime, "%B %-d, %Y")

conn <- dbGetConn(db)

review_info <- tbl(conn, "review_assignment") |>
  left_join(
    tbl(conn, "reviewer") |> select(reviewer_id = id, human, username),
    by = "reviewer_id"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    tbl(conn, "evaluation") |> select(evaluation_id = id, summary_flg),
    by = "evaluation_id"
  ) |>
  filter(
    ((human == 1 & rubric_id == rubric_version & statusCode == 2) |
      (human == 0 & rubric_id == rubric_version & statusCode == 5)) &
      summary_flg == 0
  ) |>
  collect()

reviews_by_user <- review_info |> group_by(reviewer_id, username) |> summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")
reviews_by_user |> kable()
HTML(glue("Data last modified {last_modified} - rubric version {rubric_version}"))
```

## Table 1: AI – Human Concordance (n = subset of formative evaluations we all coded)
```{r}
# Evaluations reviewed by every reviewer (AI + all humans)
n_reviewers <- n_distinct(review_info$reviewer_id)
shared_evals <- review_info |>
  distinct(evaluation_id, reviewer_id) |>
  count(evaluation_id) |>
  filter(n == n_reviewers) |>
  pull(evaluation_id)

shared_reviews <- review_info |>
  filter(evaluation_id %in% shared_evals) |>
  select(review_id = id, evaluation_id, human, sentiment = sentiment_score_value)

# Quality score on a 0-100 scale (sum of weighted, normalized components)
scores <- shared_reviews |>
  left_join(
    review_scores(conn, shared_reviews$review_id) |> select(-reviewer_id),
    by = "review_id"
  ) |>
  mutate(quality = 100 * (coverage + avg_specificity + utility))

# Quartiles of evaluations based on their mean quality score across all raters
eval_quartiles <- scores |>
  group_by(evaluation_id) |>
  summarise(eval_mean = mean(quality), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(quartile = ntile(eval_mean, 4))
scores <- scores |> left_join(eval_quartiles, by = "evaluation_id")

# Means across reviews; SDs are within-evaluation (between raters), averaged
# across evaluations
summarise_scores <- function(df, var, label) {
  df <- df |> mutate(value = {{ var }})
  per_eval <- df |>
    group_by(evaluation_id) |>
    summarise(
      sd_all = sd(value),
      sd_human = sd(value[human == 1]),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  tibble(
    Measure = label,
    mean_all = mean(df$value),
    mean_ai = mean(df$value[df$human == 0]),
    mean_human = mean(df$value[df$human == 1]),
    sd_all = mean(per_eval$sd_all),
    sd_human = mean(per_eval$sd_human)
  )
}

quartile_labels <- c("1st", "2nd", "3rd", "4th")
table1 <- bind_rows(
  summarise_scores(scores, quality, "Quality Score"),
  lapply(1:4, function(q) {
    summarise_scores(
      scores |> filter(quartile == q),
      quality,
      glue("&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;{quartile_labels[q]} Quartile")
    )
  }),
  summarise_scores(scores, sentiment, "Sentiment Score")
)

table1 |>
  kable(
    digits = 1,
    escape = FALSE,
    col.names = c(
      "",
      "Mean Score for All Raters",
      "Mean Score for AI Rater",
      "Mean Score for Human Raters",
      "Standard Deviation for All Raters",
      "Standard Deviation for Human Raters"
    )
  )
HTML(glue(
  "n = {length(shared_evals)} evaluations, {n_reviewers} reviewers ",
  "({n_distinct(review_info$reviewer_id[review_info$human == 1])} human)"
))
```
